text:
anna-partnerships: Heads-up — EdgeX hardware bundle (EDGE-BUNDLE-XL) is blocked in AWS marketplace because procurement is rejecting the PO routing. We need an emergency fix, partner is pushing launch next week.

mike-legal: @anna-partnerships can you paste the exact rejection message? I think this might be the PartnerManagedBilling clause we redlined last month.

anna-partnerships: marketplace-bot flagged it, pasted below. procurement says they can't accept a partner-managed billing flow for bundled hardware + software subscriptions.

marketplace-bot: ERROR from AWS API: 400 BAD_REQUEST - INVALID_BILLING_ROUTE: 'PartnerManagedBilling not enabled for SKU EDGE-BUNDLE-XL. Set BillingProfile to MarketplaceManaged or enable PartnerManaged via contract.'

sara-deals: We submitted the PO with our standard net30 billing profile. Partner requested partner-managed billing to consolidate invoices. Procurement refused because their ledger expects Redwood as billing owner for marketplace.

mike-legal: Ok — two questions: (1) Did the partner sign the partner-managed billing addendum? (2) Do we have an approved exception from Finance? If not, we can either get the addendum signed or switch to MarketplaceManaged on our side.

anna-partnerships: (1) EdgeX legal says they signed a version, but it's the partner's template with a reseller-credit clause we never reviewed. (2) Finance has not approved an exception.

tom-ops: From an ops angle switching to MarketplaceManaged is the fastest option if EdgeX agrees. It means Redwood shows as billing owner for the subscription and we'll invoice them separately. No infra changes, just SKU metadata update + re-publish.

kevin-sre: Small caveat: re-publishing the SKU will require a short downtime for listing metadata propagation (usually ~5-10m) and a new verification pass. We'll coordinate canary to avoid customer-facing traffic.

sara-deals: EdgeX wants consolidated invoicing for their channel partners — if we force MarketplaceManaged they'll lose that. Their SI integrators will complain. We need a workaround that preserves consolidated invoicing or a commercial tradeoff.

mike-legal: Proposed path: get EdgeX to sign our partner-managed addendum (we'll remove the reseller-credit language), then Finance issues an exception for ledger mapping. If that takes too long, temporary fallback to MarketplaceManaged to hit launch, with a TODO to migrate billing model after onboarding.

anna-partnerships: I already pinged EdgeX legal — they're meeting tomorrow at 10am PT. Can we get a documented fallback plan for launch in case signatures don't come through?

tom-ops: Yes — fallback checklist: (1) Update SKU BillingProfile to MarketplaceManaged, (2) re-publish SKU, (3) validate purchase flow end-to-end, (4) schedule a migration window to switch to PartnerManaged later. I'll draft runbook.

sara-deals: I'll prepare customer comms explaining temporary billing owner change and the migration promise. Also prepping a revenue recognition note for Finance.

mike-legal: I'll carve out the reseller-credit phrase and send a redline to EdgeX legal before their 10am. If they push back, we escalate to their GC.

anna-partnerships: Perfect. Assigning owners: @mike-legal to finalize addendum redline, @sara-deals to draft comms and Finance note, @tom-ops to create fallback runbook, @kevin-sre to prep canary window. We'll regroup after EdgeX meeting. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

marketplace-bot: Action items recorded: ticket #MKP-8821 created; notifying marketplace ingestion queue.

anna-partnerships: Follow-up: EdgeX confirmed they can sign our redline if we remove the channel-credit clause. They asked for a migration window timeline. Can we estimate time to switch billing models post-launch?\n
kevin-sre: Migration estimate: ~2 hours of coordination (non-customer impacting), plus a 24-48h settlement window for invoicing/system sync. We should plan migration on a low-traffic weekday window.

sara-deals: Noted. I'll draft migration SLA and include the timeline.

mike-legal: I'll circulate final addendum and request signature by end of day tomorrow. If signed, Finance can fast-track exception.

anna-partnerships: Great — leaving this thread open until migration complete. I'll update after EdgeX signs.
